candidates.source_name: EBRD Procurement Notices (Project Procurement / ECEPP portal)
candidates.why_relevant: Central publication point for EBRD-financed goods/works/consultancy notices and contract awards. EBRD is a major financier of Kosovo bank modernisation (Go Digital Western Balkans, SME Go Green, FIF SME), so vendor and consultant names surface here.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scheduled HTML scrape of the public notices listing filtered by country=Kosovo; ECEPP (SMART by GEP) registration needed for full notice text — treat as manual/authenticated tier.
queries_used: EBRD Kosovo bank technical cooperation procurement notice digital
candidates.observed_blocker: Search summary indicates ECEPP registration is required to view current procurement notices in full.

candidates.source_name: EBRD Project Summary Documents (PSD) — Kosovo financial institutions
candidates.why_relevant: Per-project PSDs name the client bank (Raiffeisen Bank Kosovo, ProCredit Bank Kosovo, Banka per Biznes), the instrument, and the attached technical-cooperation package — the TC package is where consultants/vendors get engaged. Archived long-term with stable IDs.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl EBRD project search filtered country=Kosovo, sector=financial institutions; snapshot PSD pages by project number.
queries_used: EBRD project summary document Kosovo bank ProCredit Raiffeisen TEB credit line technical cooperation

candidates.source_name: EBRD Technical Cooperation Project Summary Documents (TCPSD)
candidates.why_relevant: TCPSDs describe consultancy assignments (scope, budget, donor) separately from the loan — the closest EBRD analogue to a consultancy TOR, and the layer that names advisory firms working on Kosovo financial/economic institutions.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Enumerate /projects/tcpsd/{id} pages discovered via EBRD project search; monitor for Kosovo tag.
queries_used: EBRD Kosovo bank technical cooperation procurement notice digital

candidates.source_name: EBRD Kosovo news releases (financial institutions deals)
candidates.why_relevant: Press releases are the earliest public signal of a new Kosovo bank programme and usually name the partner bank, the EU/WBIF grant component and the TA package — useful as a pointer into the corresponding PSD/TCPSD and later procurement.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: RSS/news-listing polling filtered on 'Kosovo' + bank names.
queries_used: EBRD project summary document Kosovo bank ProCredit Raiffeisen TEB credit line technical cooperation

candidates.source_name: World Bank Kosovo Financial Sector Development Project (P-number project page & documents)
candidates.why_relevant: USD 52m IDA operation approved Jan 2025 covering deposit insurance capacity, underserved-firm finance and 'catalyzing faster payments' — i.e. an instant-payments build with a procurement pipeline that will name payment-platform vendors.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Track the project's Documents & Reports feed (PAD, ISR, procurement plan) plus STEP contract-award data; the World Bank Documents API supports country/project filtering.
queries_used: World Bank Kosovo financial sector payment system project procurement contract award

candidates.source_name: World Bank Documents & Reports (Kosovo financial sector corpus)
candidates.why_relevant: Archive of PADs, Implementation Status & Results reports and procurement plans. ISRs routinely disclose which contracts were signed and with whom, and are the most durable long-term record of Kosovo financial-infrastructure scope.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Use the Documents & Reports search API (country=Kosovo, majdocname/topic filters) and pull the txt/pdf renditions on a schedule.
queries_used: World Bank Kosovo financial sector payment system project procurement contract award

candidates.source_name: World Bank Procurement Contract Award Summary (borrower procurement / STEP reports)
candidates.why_relevant: Structured, downloadable award data (supplier name, country, amount, contract description) for borrower-executed procurement — the single highest-yield vendor-identification dataset for Bank-financed Kosovo projects.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Periodic dataset download/API pull filtered on borrower country = Kosovo; join to project IDs of financial-sector operations.
queries_used: World Bank Kosovo financial sector payment system project procurement contract award

candidates.source_name: World Bank corporate procurement RFx — Western Balkans instant payments assignments
candidates.why_relevant: A live example of a Bank-executed consultancy RFx on instant-payment scheme rules and overlay services covering Western Balkans target countries including Kosovo — exactly the TOR-type document this cell targets.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monitor the corporate administrative-procurement business-opportunities listing for 'payment', 'Western Balkans', 'Kosovo' keywords.
queries_used: World Bank Kosovo financial sector payment system project procurement contract award

candidates.source_name: World Bank ECA brief — Western Balkans Payment Modernization programme
candidates.why_relevant: Programme hub page describing the regional payments-modernisation effort Kosovo participates in; snowballs into country components, partner central banks and the consultancy assignments beneath it.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Snapshot page + follow outbound links quarterly.
queries_used: World Bank Kosovo financial sector payment systems project procurement

candidates.source_name: IFC Project Disclosure portal — Kosovo projects
candidates.why_relevant: IFC discloses investment and advisory projects with sponsor names and scope before signing. Kosovo entries include financial-sector clients; disclosure pages are the machine-readable entry point to IFC's Kosovo pipeline.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Query the IFC disclosures search filtered country=Kosovo, industry=financial institutions; store project-detail JSON/HTML.
queries_used: IFC advisory Kosovo bank digital payments project disclosure

candidates.source_name: IFC pressroom — IFC/SECO Digital Financial Services programme with the Central Bank of Kosovo
candidates.why_relevant: Documents a SECO-funded IFC advisory programme with BQK covering open banking and digital financial services — a donor-funded workstream that generates TORs, working groups and consultant engagements directly in the payments domain.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monitor IFC pressroom + SECO reporting; pair with BQK National Payments Council minutes for implementation detail.
queries_used: IFC Kosovo bank advisory digital payments

candidates.source_name: BQK National Payments Council (KKP) meeting minutes and presentations
candidates.why_relevant: Bilingual (sq/en) minutes and slide decks of the National Payments Council name the donor programmes (IFC/SECO, World Bank), the open-banking working group and the technical actors involved — reveals donor-funded scope that never reaches a tender portal.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl bqk-kos.org wp-content uploads and the KKP section; PDF text extraction; watch both ?lang=en and Albanian variants.
queries_used: IFC advisory Kosovo bank digital payments project disclosure

candidates.source_name: BQK Tenders page (Tenderët) — Central Bank of Kosovo own procurement
candidates.why_relevant: The central bank publishes its own contract notices and contract-award notices (Njoftim për dhënie të kontratës) as PDFs. Where donor money funds a BQK system, the award notice names the supplier — the payments-infrastructure vendor trail.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scheduled scrape of the Tenderët listing + PDF harvest and OCR/text extraction; index by CPV-like service description and awarded operator.
queries_used: "Kosovë" njoftim kontrate IPA sektori financiar bankar tender BQK

candidates.source_name: e-Prokurimi — Kosovo national electronic public procurement platform (KRPP/RRPP)
candidates.why_relevant: Where donor-financed procurement is executed by a Kosovo public body (BQK, ministries, agencies), the notice and award land here in Albanian/Serbian/English. It is the local mirror of IFI-funded contracting and names the winning economic operator.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Structured scrape of public notice search results (keywords: bankar, pagesa, sistem, softuer, TI); registration may be needed for tender dossiers — flag as authenticated tier. Unverified access model; do not assume open.
queries_used: "e-prokurimi.rks-gov.net" njoftim per dhenie te kontrates BQK sistem pagesash
candidates.observed_blocker: Not fetched in this pass; access model inferred from search summaries only.

candidates.source_name: TED — Tenders Electronic Daily (EU Official Journal supplement)
candidates.why_relevant: EU-managed IPA contracts for Kosovo (country code XK) are published as contract notices and contract award notices on TED, with full structured metadata including the awarded contractor. Long-term archive with permanent notice URLs and an open API.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: TED Search API / bulk XML packages, filtered on place-of-performance XK and CPV codes for financial/IT services (66xxxxxx, 72xxxxxx); persist notice ids.
queries_used: TED tender Kosovo banking software contract award
TED europa.eu tender Kosovo banking IPA contract notice financial sector

candidates.source_name: EU Funding & Tenders Portal — EuropeAid Kosovo (XK) prospects and calls
candidates.why_relevant: Single entry point for EuropeAid/IPA procurement and grants with Kosovo reference numbers of the form EuropeAid/NNNNNN/DD/ACT/XK. Carries forecast prospects and TOR-bearing calls before they hit TED.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Portal search API (SEDIA) filtered on '/XK' reference suffix; heavy JS front-end — prefer the JSON endpoints over HTML scraping.
queries_used: EU funding tenders portal EuropeAid Kosovo
candidates.observed_blocker: Portal is a JS single-page app; plain HTML fetch likely returns a shell.

candidates.source_name: EU Office in Kosovo / EEAS delegation pages — EU projects and tender announcements
candidates.why_relevant: The contracting authority for much Kosovo IPA money; its project and news pages announce financial-sector support (including EBRD/EU blended packages) and point to the corresponding calls.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Poll delegation news + projects listing; snowball outbound links to TED/F&T portal references.
queries_used: EU Office in Kosovo calls for tenders IPA

candidates.source_name: KosovoProjects.eu — EU-funded project database for Kosovo
candidates.why_relevant: One-stop database of EU-funded projects in Kosovo with fact sheets, beneficiaries, duration and implementing partners — the fastest way to enumerate which IPA projects touch the financial sector and who implements them.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl the project index, extract beneficiary/implementer fields, filter on financial-sector and digital keywords.
queries_used: EU funding tenders portal EuropeAid Kosovo

candidates.source_name: IPA financial assistance to Kosovo — DG NEAR action documents and project fiches
candidates.why_relevant: Action documents and project fiches define the technical scope and indicative procurement modalities of IPA support years before contracts are awarded — the upstream TOR layer for anything EU-funded touching Kosovo finance.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Harvest the annual action-programme PDF sets for Kosovo; text-search for 'financial sector', 'payments', 'banking', 'digital'.
queries_used: IPA Kosovo financial infrastructure contract notice

candidates.source_name: WBIF Procurements page — Western Balkans Investment Framework
candidates.why_relevant: WBIF grants co-finance the EU incentive and TA components attached to EBRD/EIB Kosovo bank programmes. The procurements table lists upcoming opportunities across the six beneficiaries including Kosovo.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scrape the procurements table and the Kosovo project pages; cross-reference grant IDs with EBRD/EIB project numbers.
queries_used: Western Balkans Investment Framework WBIF Kosovo project procurement documents digital

candidates.source_name: EIB calls for technical assistance / procurement (WBIF IPF series)
candidates.why_relevant: EIB publishes full TA call texts (IPF 8/10/12/13 etc.) covering digital-economy infrastructure across the Western Balkans including Kosovo, naming lots, budgets and winning consortia — durable consultancy-TOR evidence.

queries_used: Western Balkans Investment Framework WBIF Kosovo project procurement documents digital

candidates.source_name: UNDP Procurement Notices — Kosovo (UNDP-KOS references)
candidates.why_relevant: UNDP Kosovo issues consultancy TORs on digital development, economic resilience and digital profiling; occasionally the implementing channel for donor money touching financial inclusion and digital-payment adoption.

queries_used: UNDP Kosovo procurement notices

candidates.source_name: GIZ Kosovo tenders page
candidates.why_relevant: GIZ country office publishes service tenders under German/EU procurement law. Relevant as a secondary channel for German-funded advisory work touching Kosovo economic and financial governance; low but non-zero payments relevance.

queries_used: GIZ Kosovo tenders procurement financial sector

candidates.source_name: USAID Kosovo activity documents (Compete Activity, Investment Promotion and Access to Finance) and Marketlinks/DEC
candidates.why_relevant: USAID activity documents name prime contractors (Cardno Emerging Markets, Recura Financials, Canopy Lab, DT Global) and subawards to Kosovo financial institutions; DEC/Marketlinks reports carry finance-constraint analyses naming banks and products.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Harvest usaid.gov/kosovo documents plus dec.usaid.gov and marketlinks.org; mirror to local store given repeated USAID site restructuring and archive migrations.
queries_used: USAID Kosovo Compete Activity financial sector digital banking contract award MCC Kosovo compact
candidates.observed_blocker: Several USAID Kosovo pages now live on www-2021.usaid.gov or 2017-2020.usaid.gov archive hosts — high link-rot risk.

candidates.source_name: DevelopmentAid / Devex donor-tender aggregators (Kosovo financial sector)
candidates.why_relevant: Commercial aggregators mirror donor tenders and awards across EBRD/WB/EU/USAID and often retain notices after the originating portal deletes them — useful as a backfill and cross-check layer, not as a primary citation.

candidates.why_relevant: Kosovo think-tank analysis of IPA financial assistance flows; useful for reconstructing which sectors and which contracting modalities actually absorbed EU money, and for local-language actor names not present in EU documents.

negative_findings.description: Serbian/Cyrillic search for Kosovo donor procurement in banking/payments returned only Serbia-domestic World Bank and NBS material, no Kosovo-specific donor procurement source.
negative_findings.result_summary: Query "Косово тендер набавка банкарски систем плаћања ЕБРД Светска банка пројекат" surfaced mre.gov.rs, minrzs.gov.rs, mfin.gov.rs and nbs.rs documents about Serbian projects; nothing about Kosovo (XK) donor-financed financial-sector procurement.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms that for this cell the Serbian-language layer is not a productive discovery channel: IFI/EU procurement for Kosovo is published in English, and the local mirror is Albanian. Serbian-language coverage will need to come from Kosovo-institution sr-language versions rather than from open Cyrillic web search.

negative_findings.description: No Serbian-language equivalents of Kosovo donor-procurement terminology could be attached to any candidate in this slice.
negative_findings.result_summary: Every candidate discovered carries either English (IFI/EU) or Albanian (BQK, e-Prokurimi) terminology. Serbian-language terms such as 'обавештење о додели уговора' / 'javna nabavka' did not lead to Kosovo donor-financed financial-sector sources in this pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Mandatory local-language coverage is only half satisfied (sq yes, sr no). A follow-up pass should test the Serbian-language versions of Kosovo institutional sites directly rather than via search engines.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated MCC (Millennium Challenge Corporation) Kosovo financial-sector or payments procurement source was found.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches confirm Kosovo is among the countries implementing an MCC compact, but no compact procurement notice or TOR touching banking/payments surfaced. MCC Kosovo work appears energy- and governance-focused.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: MCC can be deprioritised for this cell unless a later compact component adds digital financial services; avoids wasting collector budget on a dry channel.

negative_findings.description: KfW has no discoverable Kosovo-specific tender/procurement listing for its financial-sector programmes.
negative_findings.result_summary: KfW appears in results as a funder of the Kosovo Credit Guarantee Fund (KCGF) and of financial-sector grant/lending operations, but its consultant procurement for Kosovo was not locatable via open search in this pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: KfW-funded vendor engagement in Kosovo will likely have to be inferred indirectly from KCGF publications and from KfW ex-post evaluation reports rather than from a tender feed.

negative_findings.description: EBRD's live procurement notice detail appears to sit behind ECEPP/SMART-by-GEP registration.
negative_findings.result_summary: Search summaries state registration is required to view current procurement notices. Not independently fetched, so this is a hypothesis about access, not a verified verdict.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: If confirmed, EBRD notice text needs an authenticated or manual collection tier, while EBRD PSD/TCPSD pages remain the open substitute.

coverage_gaps.description: Serbian-language (sr) coverage of this cell is effectively empty; only English and Albanian sources were productively identified.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Directly probe the sr-language versions of bqk-kos.org, e-prokurimi.rks-gov.net and rks-gov.net portals, and test Latin-script Serbian procurement terms (javna nabavka, obavestenje o dodeli ugovora, tenderska dokumentacija) rather than Cyrillic web search.

coverage_gaps.description: The access and licensing model of e-Prokurimi (Kosovo national e-procurement) was inferred from search summaries, not established by fetching the portal.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Fetch e-prokurimi.rks-gov.net directly, determine whether notice search is anonymous, whether there is a structured search/export endpoint, and check KRPP annual reports for bulk data availability.

coverage_gaps.description: No sources identified for Kosovo commercial-bank-side donor-funded IT procurement (i.e. what a bank buys with an EBRD/IFC TA grant), which is typically not publicly tendered.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Approach indirectly: EBRD/IFC TA completion reports, bank annual reports, and vendor press releases naming Kosovo bank references; treat as a reveals-indirectly source category in a later cell.

coverage_gaps.description: SECO (Swiss State Secretariat for Economic Affairs) funds the IFC digital-financial-services programme with BQK, but no SECO reporting or procurement source was catalogued.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Scout seco.admin.ch / eda.admin.ch Western Balkans cooperation reporting for the Kosovo DFS programme documents and any associated mandate procurement.

coverage_gaps.description: USAID Kosovo material is scattered across live and frozen archive hosts and UNDP purges expired notices, creating link rot in the donor-document trail.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Prioritise eager local mirroring plus Wayback Machine snapshot capture for usaid.gov/kosovo and procurement-notices.undp.org items at discovery time.

brief: Kosovo's donor- and IFI-funded financial-sector paper trail is concentrated in four durable layers: EBRD project and technical-cooperation disclosures (PSD/TCPSD) plus its registration-gated procurement portal; World Bank project documents, ISRs and borrower contract-award datasets around the 2025 USD 52m Financial Sector Development Project and the Western Balkans Payment Modernization programme; the EU stack of TED, the Funding & Tenders Portal, DG NEAR IPA action documents, WBIF and EIB TA calls; and IFC's disclosure portal plus its SECO-funded digital-financial-services advisory programme with the Central Bank of Kosovo. The highest-value local layer is Albanian: BQK's own Tenderët page publishes contract-award notices naming suppliers, and e-Prokurimi mirrors donor-financed procurement executed by Kosovo public bodies, with BQK National Payments Council minutes revealing donor scope that never reaches a tender portal. Serbian-language discovery was unproductive in this pass — open Cyrillic search returned only Serbia-domestic material — so sr coverage remains a real gap to close by probing Kosovo institutions' own sr-language pages. Aggregators (DevelopmentAid, Devex, TendersOnTime) mirror much of this but are paywalled and ToS-restricted, so they should be treated as lead-generation only, never as the collection target.
